lead_raw_text:
The structure of Tb4Si4C12 (reduced formula TbSiC3) is tetragonal with space group I4_1md (No. 143) and 20 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows carbon centers in two environments: one octahedral motif with 2 Si and 4 Tb neighbors and another tetrahedral motif with 4 C neighbors. Si centers coordinate to 4 C neighbors, while Tb centers coordinate to 8 C neighbors. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites, and polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner-sharing between C octahedra, C octahedra with C tetrahedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between C octahedra.
